utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. Just point me at the next job when you’ve got it, and I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — send me the latest list and timing, and I’ll skim it to see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m a bit foggy on the latest list. Send me the details when you can, and I’ll jump on the first repair.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I could use help sharing the repair drive location and hours. Once I’ve got Vik’s final details, I’ll send them right over.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — I’ll wait for Vik’s final details, then help share the location and hours.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll send you the location and hours as soon as Vik confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds like the best window to me too—9:30 to 11:30 should work around school drop-off and pickup. I’ll help spread the word so folks know that’s the sweet spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word too and let people know 9:30 to 11:30 is the sweet spot for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’m glad we’ve got a family-friendly window set, and I’ll keep helping get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Vik — I’m probably missing a bit, but just keep me posted when the plan’s ready and I’ll jump in to help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Noah — I’ll keep you posted and repeat the full plan as soon as it’s ready. Thanks for being willing to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. Just send me the final plan when it’s ready, and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out and pass along anything useful if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out. I’ll share the repair drive details with folks and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out, and if I hear anything useful I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course — I’m still happy to help with the repair drive. Let me know what’s needed and I can jump in after 5 or Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — I’ll check the set-aside supplies and send you the updated list with exactly what’s still needed. If anything’s missing, I’ll let you know where you can jump in after 5 or Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Cleo — send me the updated list when you have it, and I’ll jump in where needed after 5 or Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm that timing and exactly what’s still needed for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got it right.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — we’re set for the 9:30 to 11:30 window, and we still need a couple more day-of helpers plus a few folks to keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — 9:30 to 11:30, and what’s still needed is a couple more day-of helpers plus people to spread the word, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, so I’m keeping the timing and supply list up to date. If you hear anything helpful, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out and send anything helpful your way. If you need a tool or extra hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate that. I’ll keep the list current and let you know if we need an extra hand or any tools for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—send me the drive list and I’ll help sort it out. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — I’ll send over the drive list and flag the first few fixes. If you can help sort and prioritize them, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — send it over and I’ll sort the priority list. What’s the first fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I’m usually the last to hear about these things, so I appreciate it. If anything changes with the repair drive, just let me know when you can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — I will. I’m checking the details first, then I’ll share any updates on the repair drive as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I appreciate you checking first. Just let me know when you’ve got the latest on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 works for me. I’ll bring the tools and help spread the word, and your checklist will keep us on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks, Eli — I’ll send over the checklist and a quick rundown so we’re not scrambling. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll update it right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll keep an eye out for your rundown and see you Saturday at 10 with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — if you can help at the sorting table or bring packing tape, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that—I'll help at the sorting table and bring some packing tape too. Thank you, Mara, that really helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll point you to the sorting table when you arrive.
